note:
Re-measured at 18; the floor said 21. Not this commit's doing -- the tree reads 18 with the ported modules present and 18 with them held aside, so the three were repaid by somebody who did not bank them, and an exact ratchet fails in the falling direction too.

The ten ported modules add none: every remaining unresolved call is in a module that predates them (sale_edi_ubl 6, l10n_it_edi 3, l10n_cl 3, and five singletons). Six further modules were pulled from the mirror in the same pass and dropped again rather than banked, because they call base APIs this fork does not have -- l10n_fr_pdp alone had 31 into an account_peppol that diverges from the mirror by +4310/-18885 lines.

--- APPENDED ON REBASE, 2026-08-29: 18 -> 17.

origin did not move this floor -- its count is identical to the merge-base's, and only its note changed -- so the drop is this branch's alone. The superseded note from this branch follows.

--- FROM THIS BRANCH:

18 -> 17: odoo/tests/suite.py's `self._removeTestAtIndex(index)`, into EXTERNAL.

The receiver is `unittest.suite.BaseTestSuite`, which `TestSuite` derives, so
this is the third of the three things the gate's docstring says an unresolved
call can be -- a reach into a base outside the repository -- and not a typo or a
deleted method. Checked at the call site rather than assumed, as that docstring
requires: `'_removeTestAtIndex' in vars(BaseTestSuite)` is True on the CPython
this fork runs, and the method is what drops the reference to a finished test.
`_cleanup`, read on the line above it, is an attribute rather than a call and
was never in the count.

WHY IT SURFACED NOW. It is the only gate of its family that does NOT skip test
paths, and its own docstring says so and names this file among the seven such
rows it floors. Everything else that measures odoo/tests goes through
`_sources.is_test_path`, which calls any path with a `tests` component a test
path -- so the package the whole commit is about was visible to this gate and to
almost nothing else. This row is what that visibility bought.

Measured in a detached worktree at c0a918326d3 with only this change's files
copied in: 18 with nothing applied, 17 with them.
